statement: Gross domestic product per person, current US dollars, 1986 baseline against the most recent full-year figure.
provenance: Uganda Bureau of Statistics national accounts; World Bank World Development Indicators (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD).
basis: The 1986 figure reflects the post-conflict trough; the trajectory holds across both national and Bretton-Woods series. Approved figure fixed for this record.

statement: Installed national generation capacity: one ageing dam (Nalubaale) in 1986 against the grid of 2024–26 including Karuma (600 MW), Isimba (183 MW), Bujagali (250 MW) and grid solar.
provenance: Electricity Regulatory Authority (ERA) installed-capacity statistics; Ministry of Energy and Mineral Development.
basis: Capacity, not dispatch. The 2,048 MW milestone follows the commissioning of Karuma. Approved figure fixed for this record.

statement: Share of the population below the national poverty line, early-1990s baseline against the most recent Uganda National Household Survey round.
provenance: Uganda Bureau of Statistics — Uganda National Household Survey series (1992/93 baseline of 56.4%).
basis: Measured against the national line, not the international $2.15 line. Approved figure fixed for this record.

statement: Refugees and asylum-seekers hosted on Ugandan territory — the largest refugee population in Africa.
provenance: UNHCR Uganda operational data portal; Office of the Prime Minister (Department of Refugees).
basis: Under the Refugee Act 2006: land allocation, freedom of movement, right to work. Approved figure fixed for this record.

statement: Unbroken constitutional order from January 1986 to 2026, after a quarter-century marked by coups and civil war.
provenance: Constitution of the Republic of Uganda (1995); national historical record.
basis: The anniversary this record marks. Approved figure fixed for this record.

statement: Literacy 43% → 70%+; ~5,000 factories from 80; HIV prevalence −70% through the 1990s; 51% household electricity access; 51 km Kampala–Entebbe Expressway; ~230,000 barrels/day oil at peak; Bidi Bidi and Nakivale settlements.
provenance: UBOS statistical abstracts; Ministry of Health HIV estimates (peak ~15% c.1991 to ~5% by 2001); UNRA project records; Petroleum Authority of Uganda projections; UNHCR settlement profiles.
basis: Contextual figures supporting the five approved figures; each traces to the cited public series.

statement: Thirteen landscape photographs of Uganda (Lake Bunyonyi, Sipi Falls, Rwenzori, Bwindi, Mount Elgon, Queen Elizabeth NP, Murchison Falls, Kigezi terraces, Lake Victoria at Jinja); twenty-five illustrative plates (hero portrait fusion, topographic, ledger and ceremonial surfaces) generated for this record.
provenance: Photography: supplied production archive — rights to be confirmed with the Presidential Press Unit before public launch. Illustrative plates: commissioned AI-assisted generations, treated as artwork, not documentary evidence.
basis: Two generated plates were rejected at intake (wrong national geography; degenerate output) and do not appear. All geography used for data display is drawn from surveyed coordinates, not generated art.

statement: TeX Gyre Heros & TeX Gyre Heros Cn (GUST e-foundry), self-hosted subsets — the URW Nimbus Sans lineage of the Helvetica design.
provenance: GUST Font Licence (free to embed and distribute). Platform Helvetica Neue is used where the operating system provides it.
basis: No commercial font files are distributed with this site.
